player_intent: Play as the downloaded modern soldier, customize cosmetic gear and garment tint, and retain the existing game movement and weapon behavior.
acceptance_rule: Character creator saves a sanitized appearance consumed by main; local and network operators select the new compatible skeleton; hand, animation and rendered checks pass.

nodes.role: Edits the saved appearance and previews the production player.
Selects a compatible visual asset before the existing driver binds its skeleton.
Production actor instantiated with physics/input disabled only for preview.

visual_check: Main player and creator: clothing and eyes, trigger hand, support palm, ADS, crouch, prone, run, reload and dives. Local cosmetic selections are not yet replicated to peers.

rig_audit.reason: Expanded regression verifies unchanged canonical hierarchy/rests, inverse binds, valid weights and track targets, all vertices through 24 deformation samples, and local/network rest parity. Keep the rig and merge stronger regression coverage; this is not hand-surface or full network sign-off.

system_delta.reason: Replace the visible asset with an offline compatible derivative while keeping the proven runtime skeleton rest, pose writer and gameplay owners. Add a shared saved cosmetic profile rather than a preview-only model.

candidate.system: Modern compatible operator with shared character creator
